Definition: Ephah, the name of a son of Midian, and of the region settled by him; also of an Israelite and of an Israelitess
BiblicalUsage: Ephah = "gloomy"; n pr m; 1) a son of Midian; 2) a Judaite, son of Jahdai; n pr f; 3) a concubine of Caleb in the line of Judah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
